parole.significato: assassin (someone who intentionally kills a person, especially a professional who kills a public or political figure)
parole.testo: From French assassin, from Arabic حَشَّاشِين (ḥaššāšīn, “hashish users”), حَشِيش (ḥašīš, “hay, dried herb”).
From French cheik, from Arabic شَيْخ (šayḵ, “elder”), from شَاخَ (šāḵa, “to grow old”).

From its use in Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves, translating French Sésame, ouvre-toi in Antoine Galland's version of the Ali Baba story in the One Thousand and One Nights, possibly based on an oral Arabic source.
